vot_scorpid_trouble.accept_text:
East of camp, out at the scorpid nest. Thin the workers - there's no chasing needed in this one.

And watch their tails, not their claws. That's where the lesson is.

vot_vile_familiars.accept_text:
East along the ridge, past the scorpid nest - the Burning Blade Coven is the cave mouth in the rocks above it.

I've stood this watch three seasons and never saw a demon before last week. Whatever's in there isn't from around here either - kind of like you, maybe, though I doubt it's as friendly. Start with the familiars. Don't go deeper without backup.

vot_felstalkers.accept_text: Same cave - the Coven, east past the scorpid nest. You'll see the hounds before you see the familiars, most likely, whelps and pups both, running in packs. Doesn't matter which you kill. Six dead hounds is six dead hounds, whichever kind they are.

vot_ritual_disruption.accept_text: Back into the Coven, east past the scorpid nest, and this time keep going. Initiates in the outer halls. Ritual guards in the hall with the circle. Kill the guards first if you can - they're the ones who'll finish it. I'll hold the road behind you.

vot_yarrog_baneshadow.accept_text: He's at the very back of the Burning Blade Coven, east past the scorpid nest, past the hall where the circle was. He summons more of them the longer the fight runs - don't let them stack up on you, or you'll be fighting the whole coven at once. Focus him, finish it fast. I'd go myself if the valley could spare the watch. It can't. So it's you.

vot_fel_shards.accept_text: The Burning Blade Coven - north-east of here, the cave above the scorpid nest. The acolytes keep the shards on their belts. Don't touch them with bare hands. Use tongs. Or a stick. Or a different hand. I'll be here, doing my own science.

vot_carrion_circle.accept_text: South-east, out over the Windrift Dunes - that's where they sit between visits. They think I'm already dead. I'd like to change their minds. Vultures first; the jackals only get brave when there's something circling. Don't tell Nakhtar I'm giving out work.

vot_brood_below.accept_text: The Den again, west of camp, and past the mouth this time. Caves lie. They tell you the next room is safe because it's quiet. Then you step in and find out why it was quiet. Clear the halls, then the nursery. One room at a time.

vot_nest_guardian.accept_text: The deepest room of the Den, west of camp - past the nursery you cleared. It's a soft boss, as these things go in this valley. But it's still a boss, and you haven't fought one yet. Don't get comfortable just because I called it soft. Go find out what your hands do when the stakes are real.

vot_silk_for_rhaka.accept_text: The Den is north-west of here, the cave in the ridge. Spools, from the webspinners in its halls - they keep them at their backs. Don't take the loose thread, it's sticky. The spools are what you want. Be careful. Please.

vot_grosks_trophy.accept_text: Out in the Windrift Dunes, east of here, where the road runs into sand. It's a white one. Scar over the left eye. Quick as anything, but it's old - old things get careless. I'd do it myself except... my mother. You understand.

vot_gulpjaw.accept_text: Trailwater Spring, south of camp - the same shallows. He sits at the bottom and waits. Don't wade in. Pull him out onto the bank; everything slow is worse in water than out of it.

vot_heartwood.accept_text: The sagewood grove, south-east of my fire. It's the grove's own heart gone sour. Saplings first - they'll tell you where the old one is. Fire works, if you have it. It also makes the grove very angry, so do it quickly.

vot_cinderjaw.accept_text: South-west, past the lake, and keep the road under your feet until it stops being a road - the Wastes start where the ground goes black. Don't fight on the black stone. It holds heat. Smolderhide will find you - it always finds you. Be ready when it does.

vot_den_scout.accept_text: The Den is the shallow cave in the ridge west of camp. Caves aren't like open ground: tight rooms, narrow tunnels, and one wrong corner puts two or three of them on you at once instead of one. That's not a warning to scare you off. It's just how caves fight. Go in. Look around properly - not only at what's trying to kill you. Come back and tell me what you noticed.
